offers.title: UX/UI Designer (m/f/d)
offers.description:
About the role:

As a UX/UI Designer, you will shape intuitive and user-centered experiences for complex digital products within the Quantum Systems ecosystem.

You will work at the intersection of users, product, and engineering, translating complex workflows and technical requirements into clear, efficient, and visually compelling interfaces.

From early user flows and wireframes to interactive prototypes and polished UI designs, you will take ownership of the design process and collaborate closely with Product Managers and Software Engineers to turn ideas and requirements into solutions that work in real-world environments.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design intuitive and efficient user experiences for complex web applications, platforms, and technical systems.

  • Translate complex user workflows, product requirements, and technical constraints into clear and accessible UX concepts.

  • Create user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs using Figma.

  • Design data-heavy and operational interfaces such as dashboards, maps, monitoring views, configuration screens, and control applications.

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, and other stakeholders throughout the entire product-development lifecycle.

  • Contribute to and continuously improve our design system, ensuring consistency, scalability, and usability across our products.

  • Participate in design reviews and actively incorporate feedback into iterative design improvements.

  • Clearly communicate and defend design decisions based on user needs, product requirements, usability principles, and technical constraints.

  • Balance usability, visual quality, technical feasibility, and product requirements when developing design solutions.

  • Support the continuous improvement of UX/UI processes and help establish strong design practices across our growing product landscape.
offers.requirements:
What you bring to the team:

  • You have 3+ years of professional experience in UX/UI or Product Design, preferably working on complex web applications, platforms, enterprise software, or technical products.

  • You have a strong understanding of both UX and UI design principles and know how to apply them in real-world products.

  • You are comfortable understanding complex workflows and technical requirements and turning them into simple and intuitive user experiences.

  • You have hands-on experience creating user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and production-ready UI designs.

  • You have experience designing data-heavy interfaces, such as dashboards, maps, configuration tools, monitoring systems, or control applications.

  • You are highly proficient in Figma.

  • You have practical experience working with and contributing to design systems and reusable component libraries.

  • You have experience collaborating closely with Product Managers and Software Engineers from early concept development through implementation.

  • You can clearly explain your design decisions and connect them to user needs, business or product requirements, and technical constraints.

  • You are comfortable receiving feedback, challenging assumptions constructively, and iterating on your designs.

  • You enjoy solving complex problems and bringing structure and simplicity to technically challenging products.

  • Communicating in English comes naturally to you.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

offers.title: Corporate Security Manager (m/f/d) - Quantum Frontline Industries
offers.description:
Quantum Frontline Industries (QFI) is a newly established German-Ukrainian defence joint venture between Quantum Systems and Frontline Robotics, created under the Build with Ukraine initiative. For the first time, Ukrainian drones will be manufactured on an industrial scale in Europe, combining Ukrainian battlefield-proven technology with German industrial automation to create a new model of cross-border defence co-production: the German Model.

As Corporate Security Manager (m/f/d), you will be responsible for protecting our employees, facilities, assets, and sensitive information from physical and security-related risks. In this critical role, you will develop and implement security strategies, oversee site protection, coordinate crisis and emergency response activities, and ensure compliance with applicable regulations and internal security standards.

Working closely with Production, Supply Chain, Quality, HR, external security providers, and public authorities, you will help build and maintain a secure, resilient, and compliant operating environment in a dynamic international defence manufacturing setting.

What is Your Day to Day Mission?

Security Strategy & Risk Management

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve company-wide corporate security policies, standards, and procedures.

  • Conduct security risk assessments and threat analyses for facilities, personnel, operations, and company assets.

  • Identify security vulnerabilities and develop effective preventive and protective measures.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, and internal security requirements.

  • Promote security awareness and contribute to building a strong security culture across the organization.

Physical Security & Site Protection

  • Design, evaluate, and oversee physical security systems including access control, CCTV, intrusion detection, and alarm systems.

  • Conduct site security inspections, audits, and vulnerability assessments.

  • Develop and implement measures to protect employees, facilities, equipment, and critical infrastructure.

  • Manage and monitor external security providers, guarding services, and security technology partners.

  • Ensure appropriate security standards are maintained across production, warehouse, and office environments.

Crisis & Emergency Management

  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve emergency response, evacuation, and crisis management plans.

  • Coordinate responses to security incidents, threats, emergencies, and business disruptions.

  • Organize and conduct crisis exercises, security drills, and employee awareness training.

  • Support business continuity and organizational resilience initiatives to ensure operational readiness.

Investigations & Incident Management

  • Lead internal investigations related to security incidents, theft, fraud, misconduct, or violations of company policies.

  • Document incidents, conduct root cause analyses, and drive corrective and preventive actions.

  • Support investigations in coordination with relevant authorities and external partners when required.

  • Assess travel and personnel security risks, particularly for international travel or operations in high-risk regions.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Collaborate closely with government agencies, law enforcement authorities, and external security partners.

  • Advise managers and business functions on all corporate security-related matters.

  • Develop security reports, KPIs, and management dashboards to provide transparency and support decision-making.

  • Contribute to cross-functional projects with a focus on security, compliance, and risk mitigation.
offers.requirements:
What you bring to the team:

  • Bachelor's degree in Security Management, Risk Management, Criminology, Business Administration, or a comparable field.

  • Several years of professional experience in Corporate Security, Industrial Security, Protective Services, or a related security management function.

  • Proven experience managing security investigations, incident response, and crisis management processes.

  • Experience working with government authorities, law enforcement agencies, and external security providers.

  • Experience in manufacturing, industrial, defence, aerospace, or other security-sensitive environments is highly desirable.

  • Strong knowledge of physical security systems, including access control, surveillance, intrusion detection, and alarm management.

  • Experience in risk management, security planning, emergency preparedness, and business continuity.

  • Understanding of relevant legal, regulatory, and security compliance requirements.

  • Professional certifications such as Certified Protection Professional (CPP), Certified Security Manager (CSM), or similar qualifications are considered an advantage.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured and pragmatic approach.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and drive security initiatives across the organization.

  • High level of integrity, discretion, professionalism, and accountability.

  • Professional communication skills in English or German; Ukrainian language skills are a significant advantage.

offers.title: Project Manager
offers.description:
Quantum Systems  next-generation unmanned solutions across air, land, and sea. From advanced aerial drones to underwater and ground platforms, our systems combine cutting-edge hardware with AI-driven software for seamless control and real-time data insights. Trusted by defense, security, and public sector clients worldwide, we redefine mission versatility and performance.

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to take end-to-end ownership of complex hardware and software development projects, from scope and planning through to delivery. You will work with cross-functional engineering teams and be accountable for predictable delivery that stays aligned with business objectives.

This role suits a Middle Strong or Senior PM who works independently, makes decisions under uncertainty, and brings structure to teams without formal authority over them.

This is a full-time office job. Candidates must be located in Kyiv.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own project planning and execution: scope, milestones, schedules, and resource allocation

  • Coordinate teams across hardware, software, embedded, and systems engineering

  • Track progress and dependencies, and ensure agreed milestones are delivered on time

  • Identify and mitigate risks, remove blockers, and manage changes to scope and timelines

  • Run planning sessions, project meetings, and status reviews that keep teams aligned

  • Report on status, risks, and delivery outlook to stakeholders and leadership

  • Maintain plans, documentation, and reporting in Jira, Confluence, or similar tools

  • Improve project management processes and team efficiency
offers.requirements:
What you bring to the team:

  • 5+ years of project management experience, preferably in hardware, embedded systems or defense

  • Proven track record of delivering complex technical projects with cross-functional engineering teams

  • Strong command of planning, scope, schedule, and resource management

  • Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum and/or hybrid methodologies

  • Ability to manage risks, dependencies, competing priorities, and changing requirements

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

  • Structured thinking, ownership, and a proactive approach to problem-solving

  • Proficiency in Jira, Confluence, or similar tools

  • English at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or higher

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We Stand with Ukraine!

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside the box, and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.
